description:
## Objective

Keep one ReAct benchmark family with distinct memory, state-growth, and fresh-workflow checks.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U18`
Covers: `R1, R2, R7; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD7, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.7 (U7) — Port Action and Flow benchmark smoke checks must be complete; jido-07x.15 (U15) — Port offline AI examples must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.20 (U20) — Enforce quality gates in CI and agent guidance must be complete.

## Files

Read AI baseline `test/bench/**`, post-baseline `react_fresh_memory.exs` at `65cc5fda0380c0b95fef955687495b8786d03e3b`, and current `bench/react_memory.exs`. Add `test/bench/ai/**` and `bench/ai/**` only for distinct checks. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Keep `bench/react_memory.exs` as the current memory owner.
2. Add the baseline state-growth check when it proves a distinct invariant.
3. Add the fresh-workflow check with its post-baseline commit when it proves a distinct invariant.
4. Use deterministic model and tool fixtures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each AI benchmark metric has one documented owner.
- [ ] No duplicate ReAct implementation enters `lib/**`.
- [ ] Offline benchmark checks need no provider key.

## Verification

- `mix test.bench test/bench/ai` and all documented offline `mix bench.*` commands exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

Verification passed: 3 focused AI benchmark tests, 20 complete benchmark tests, both documented manual runners with two requests, 14 manifest/contract tests, formatting, and diff checks. No lib/** or refs/** changes. No deferred U18 assets, deviations, or remaining blockers.
